senses.gloss: --group of three: वर्ण loka, etc. वा. ९७. ३३.

(I)--शिव;
1: Br. II. २७. ६९; Vi. I. १५. १२२.
his riding animal वृषभ,
2: Br. III. ७२. ८२; ७४. ५१.
followed by the नैऋऋत clan of राक्षसस्;
3: Ib. III. 7. १४१.
one of the eleven Rudras; the eighth of twelve incarnations who slew Asuras in the battle of Andhaka;
4: M. 5. २९; ४७. ५०; १९१. १२०.
sacrifice to, by पुरोडाश made in कपालस्; गायत्री, त्रिष्टुब् and Jagati are present as three means of the पुरोडाश;
5: वा. ३१. ४६-8; ४०. २०.
with ten arms in शिवपुर; his weapons are पट्टिश, bow, trident, and sword; Gandharva leaders entertain him with music; the bull is there, and Skanda and others form the सभा; sculptures of Dig Devas in the columns of the palace.
6: Ib. १०१. २५५. २९२, ३२३.
Ambakas are the yonis of Vanaspati, king of trees;
7: Br. II. 9. 4.
curse of दक्ष to be born as प्राचेतस् in the चाक्षुष Manu epoch.
8: Ib. II. १३. ४१, १४४.
[page२-039+ ३५]

(II)--Kubera whose followers were of the राक्षस gan2a नैऋऋत, many branches of which गण were worshippers of शन्कर;
1: वा. ६९. १७३.
killed all in Tripura.
2: वा. ९७. ८२; ९९. ५१.
--the vow that leads to the world of शिव. M. १०१. ६७.
--a son of Vipracitti. Vi. I. २१. ११.
(I)--a daughter of सविता. भा. VI. १८. 1.
--the son of भानु, and father of Karan- dama. Vi. IV. १६. 3.
--a son of Uruksava and वीशाला; became a Brahmana. M. ४९. ३९.
--as a शक्ति resident in शोदसपत्राब्ज. Br. IV. ३२. १५. [page२-040+ २८]

--by the agitation of the गुणस् or qualities three gods with body came into being; the Rajas is ब्रह्मा, Tamas Agni and Satva, विष्णु; the first had the duty of creation, the second काल and the third उदासीन; these are three worlds, three Vedas and three fires, one dependent on the other; by their joint action the world progresses; (Advaita): three functions of प्रजापति as creator, destroyer and protector. वा. 5. १४-16 and ३०-31.
(I)--a son of दुरितक्षय (दुरितक्षय- वि। प्।) and a पौराणिक. भा. IX. २१. १९; XII. 7. 5; Vi. IV. १९. २५.
(IV)--a son of विशाला. वा. ९९. १६३.

(II)--the Veda व्यास of the fifteenth द्वापर.
1: Br. II. ३५. १२०; Vi. III. 3. १५.
Heard the पुराण from अन्तरिक्ष and narrated it to Dhanamjaya.
2: Br. IV. 4. ६२.
(III)--the son of त्रिधन्वा and father of Satyavrata. Br. III. ६३. ७६; M. १२. ३७; Vi. IV. 3. २०-1.
--the son of अनरण्य. वा. ८८. ७६.
--the son of Purukutsa. वा. ८८. ७४.
(III)--a मन्त्रकृत् and of the Angirasa branch. Br. II. ३२. १०८; वा. ५९. ९९.
(II)--(Trasadas-वा। प्।, ब्र्। प्।) son of नर्मदा and Purukutsa, and father of अनरण्य. भा. IX. 7. 4; Br. III. १०. ९८; वा. ७३. ४९; ८८. ७४; Vi. IV. 3. १६-17.

(I)--an atom;
1: भा. III. ११. 5.
the visible speck floating in the sun, seen as the sun shines through a window: a measure- ment.
2: M. २५८. १७.
Padmarajas;
3: वा. १०१. ११९.
eight times the परमाणु.
4: Br. III. १०. ५९; IV. 2. ११९.
--a son of Ranti and a great charioteer. वा. ९९. १२९.
--राक्षसस् fearful to children. वा. ६९. १९१.
